name: PlaceholderFormat
description: Contains properties that apply specifically to placeholders, such as placeholder type.
example:
With ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Shapes.Placeholders
    If .Count > 0 Then
        With .Item(1)
            Select Case .PlaceholderFormat.Type
                Case ppPlaceholderTitle
                    .TextFrame.TextRange = "Title Text"

                Case ppPlaceholderCenterTitle
                    .TextFrame.TextRange = "Centered Title Text"

                Case Else
                    MsgBox "There's no horizontal " _
                        "title on this slide"
            End Select
        End With
    End If
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Represents the type of placeholder. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the specified object. Read/write.

properties.name: ContainedType
properties.description: Returns the type of the shape that contains the specified placeholder format. Read-only.
